keyMappings:
#!no-check
# --- VIMIUM C: COLEMAK-DH (KNEI) FULL MAP ---
unmapAll

# 1. Scrolling (home row)
map n scrollLeft
map e scrollDown
map i scrollUp
map o scrollRight
map h scrollPageUp
map l scrollPageDown

# 2. Tab cycling: Shift+home row (E=down, I=up — matches scroll direction)
map E nextTab
map I previousTab
map ^ visitPreviousTab

# 3. History moves to N/O (the leftover shifted pair)
map N goBack
map O goForward

# 3. Hints + Vomnibar
map f LinkHints.activate
map F LinkHints.activateOpenInNewForegroundTab
map b Vomnibar.activateBookmarks
map B Vomnibar.activateBookmarksInNewTab
map ; Vomnibar.activate

# 4. Tabs
map x removeTab
map X restoreTab
map t createTab
map r reload
map R reloadTab

# 5. Page position
map gg scrollToTop
map G scrollToBottom

# 6. Find
map / enterFindMode
map p performFind
map P performBackwardsFind

# 7. URL / marks / misc
map yy copyCurrentUrl
map gu goUp
map gU goToRoot
map m Marks.activateCreateMode
map ` Marks.activateGotoMode
map gi focusInput
map a enterInsertMode
map v enterVisualMode
map ? showHelp
map <a-p> togglePinTab
map d scrollPageDown
map u scrollPageUp
